rcaReport.summary: The CPU utilization spiked to critical levels, saturating system cores.
rcaReport.rootCause: Infinite process loop or runaway thread in Node worker process (PID 4819).
rcaReport.impact: Severely delayed event loop execution, causing API timeout rates to rise above 8%.
rcaReport.technicalAnalysis: CPU usage spiked to 94%+ while RAM remained stable. SSH diagnostics `ps aux` command showed Node worker thread occupying 94.2% CPU resources.
remediationSteps: Audit event loop blocking operations in the worker scheduler code.
Configure CPU quota limits in the systemd service file (`CPUQuota=80%`).

rcaReport.summary: A critical memory starvation alert occurred, triggering system warnings.
rcaReport.rootCause: V8 Engine Heap space leakage in the background queues processor node daemon.
rcaReport.impact: Node process was terminated by the Linux Out Of Memory (OOM) Killer, leading to downtime.
rcaReport.technicalAnalysis: RAM utilization rose incrementally from 48% to 96%. Logs reveal minor GC operations exceeding 400ms followed by OOM-kill logs in `dmesg` killing process ID 4819.
remediationSteps: Increase heap memory limit parameter: `--max-old-space-size=4096` in start command.
Verify memory retention in global event listener registries inside queue listeners.
Restart the systemd unit: `systemctl restart web-service`.

rcaReport.summary: The primary filesystem storage reached full capacity.
rcaReport.rootCause: Runaway application debug logs writing excessively without logrotation configuration.
rcaReport.impact: System unable to write temporary files or session records, causing write operations to crash.
rcaReport.technicalAnalysis: Disk storage capacity grew to 98% utilization. SSH diagnostic output of `df -h` confirms `/dev/root` mounted on `/` has only 1.2G available disk space.
remediationSteps: Locate largest directory consumers using `du -ah /var/log | sort -rh | head -10`.
Safely truncate large debug log file: `truncate -s 0 /var/log/web-app/debug.log`.
Add disk alerts at 80% usage to catch issues before partition exhaustion.

rcaReport.rootCause: Nginx worker connection starvation and Postgres DB connection pool saturation.
